narrative.details: You are learning, champion.  Let us test your skills with the mature cats now. Kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers this time out.
narrative.objectives: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
narrative.offerRewardText: I am impressed, champion.  You are progressing quite well.
narrative.requestItemsText: If you strive for greater challenges you must first prove yourself with the task at hand. Return to me after you've killed 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
